name: Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet pressed together, knees dropped open wide, and elbows braced lightly against the floor.
Tuck your chin gently toward your chest and keep your upper back grounded.
Drive through the outer edges of your feet to lift your hips upward until your glutes contract strongly at the top.
Lower your hips smoothly back to touch the floor lightly before pressing into the next repetition.
tips: Keep your knees flared outward and ribs tucked down so the work stays strictly in your glutes rather than your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top of each repetition for a full glute squeeze.
